notes: Access: curl_cffi chrome124 browser impersonation past the Cloudflare JS challenge. robots.txt checked (no Claude-specific disallow) but disallows /s/ (search) for all agents -- no /s/ URLs were fetched. Checked homepage, sitemap-categories.xml (3098 URLs -- no dedicated Neuheiten/New-Arrivals category node in the product taxonomy), sitemap-cms.xml (547 CMS pages) scanned for neu/neuheit/neuank-named pages -> found /c/neu, /c/neuheiten, /c/neue-moebel. Individual product 'New' badge text confirmed as a PDP-level eyecatcher only ('wxs.availability.new.eyecatcherClickable.modal.modalContent':'Dieser Artikel befindet sich neu im Sortiment' = 'This item is newly in the assortment') -- a per-product label, not a page. FOUND, ALL EXCLUDED as non-PLP / search-routed: (1) /c/neu ('Neuheiten bei moemax') is a CMS 'interiorIdeas'-type inspiration page, H2 'Neuheiten nach Kategorien:' ('New arrivals by category:'), showing 40 curated tiles with NO totalResults/pageSize/pagination anywhere -- its per-category 'view more' links all resolve to /s/?p_eyecatcher=Neu&p_parentcategories=...&sort=... (a faceted SEARCH endpoint filtered by the 'New' eyecatcher badge), which is both robots-disallowed and explicitly excluded per Sec.3 as a search-results/arbitrary-filter page, not a dedicated New Arrivals PLP. One link uses a normal category URL with a sort param only (/alle-teppiche-C32C1?sort=p_haseyecatchernew_desc) -- this re-orders the SAME full Teppiche category population by 'has new badge' rather than filtering to a distinct new-arrivals subset, so it is not a separate listing either (same total count as the parent category, already covered under Furniture in the separate Home-Decor/Furniture project). (2) /c/neuheiten ('Neuheiten bei moemax - Neue Moebel & Wohnaccessoires') is a 'Happy new year!' New-Year seasonal campaign CMS page (H2 'Unsere neuesten Wohnaccessoires'), same pattern -- its 8 tiles' 'view more' links also resolve to /s/?ec_category=...&sort=p_haseyecatchernew_desc (disallowed search endpoint). (3) /c/neue-moebel ('Wenn deine Moebel nicht mehr zu deinem Leben passen, hol dir neue bei moemax!') is a pure editorial/buying-guide article with 0 product tiles -- excluded as editorial content. No dedicated, independently-countable New Arrivals PLP exists anywhere on the site; every 'new' signal on moemax.de is either a per-product eyecatcher badge or a sort/filter applied to the disallowed search endpoint or to an existing full category listing (not a distinct population). This matches the established finding for the sister brand XXXLutz DE (SR105, same SAP-Commerce-family platform): 'no New Arrivals since the site's own Neu facet has no dedicated hub page' -- moemax.de shows the identical architecture. Absence conclusion: no genuine New-Arrivals-type merchandising PLP exists on moemax.de as of 2026-09-08.
